name: manual_85f296
claim: Before running any test that can reach model code, including a first run that is expected to fail, make the engines unreachable and prove it: a kernel sandbox for the agent's own runs, and an audit hook above every test directory that refuses the engine ports. A failing test executes the old, unguarded code for real.

decisions.notes: 2026-11-28 local 12:17:19: a first-run test executed memory code not yet routed through the gate and loaded bge-m3 with no person's approval. The runner had set only one of the endpoint variables the code could read.
